title: Adaptive focus trap and locale-aware numeric input behavior for Cost Explorer
creator: Jonas Patel
description:
Background: Cost Explorer includes interactive sparklines, per-route rollup rows and inline numeric inputs (filters, quick-edits). Several accessibility regressions were flagged in the last QA sweep: focus traps on the filter flyout do not expose a stable tab order in RTL locales, screen readers announce decimal separators inconsistently for locale-formatted numbers, and the high-contrast theme drops several stroke contrasts on sparkline paths.

Goal: Deliver a prototype and design spec that addresses (1) adaptive focus trapping that preserves logical reading order in LTR/RTL and for both keyboard-only users and assistive tech, (2) locale-aware numeric input patterns (placeholder, aria-valuetext, and keyboard interactions) for comma/period decimal separators, and (3) revised sparkline color tokens and stroke weights to meet WCAG AA for low-vision/high-contrast modes. The output should include annotated Figma screens, an interactive prototype, and acceptance criteria for engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard tab order in Cost Explorer filter flyout follows visual reading order in both LTR and RTL when tested with VoiceOver and NVDA
Focus trap implementation supports nested focus zones (sparkline legend tooltip + filter modal) without breaking global keyboard shortcuts
Numeric inputs expose aria-valuetext that mirrors localized number formatting and VoiceOver reads decimal separators correctly for en-US, fr-FR, and ar-SA locales
High-contrast sparkline tokens meet 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the card background at 1px and 2px stroke weights; tokens fall back to patterned fills when color alone is insufficient
Design handoff includes Figma spec pages, CSS token mappings, example localized strings, and a short JS snippet demonstrating aria-valuetext generation
Prototype demonstrates behavior for at least three locales and both keyboard and screenreader flows
review_comments: PM review (Aisha Khan): 'Please call out fallback pattern for users with reduced-motion enabled — some sparkline animations are distracting.'
Accessibility lead (Ruth Gomez): 'Great start. For aria-valuetext show examples for negative numbers and large units (1,234.56 vs 1A0234,56) and confirm keyboard comma/period insertion behavior.'
Engineering feedback (Diego Ramirez): 'Concern: nested focus zones may require small runtime change to focus manager; mark as dependency for ENG-21402.'
tasks: Create Figma master components for numeric input with locale formatting variants
Prototype focus-trap behavior in Figma + interactive links for LTR/RTL flows
Run contrast checks using Axe and manual colorblind simulation; export token suggestions
Draft acceptance-test checklist and attach to PRD
Present prototype at design review and collect signoffs
dev_notes: Prefer aria-valuetext generation on the client to avoid server-side locale mismatch; include tests for Intl.NumberFormat variants
Suggest adding a 'data-locale' attribute on the cost-card to allow CSS direction-specific selectors
If pattern fill fallback is used, provide a small legend explaining pattern mappings for colorblind users
Coordinate with ENG-21402 for runtime focus-manager changes
